rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something repulsive, gross, or distasteful.

example.jyutping: ni1 wun2 sung3 tai2 lok6 hou2 wat6 dat6

rows.note: Use this for something that makes you feel disgusted, especially an unpleasant act, idea, or sight.

example.english: Picking his nose in front of people is really disgusting.
example.traditional: 佢喺人哋面前抹鼻屎，真係嘔心。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 jan4 dei6 min6 cin4 mut3 bei6 si2 zan1 hai6 au2 sam1

rows.note: Use this when the disgusting thing is nauseating or makes you feel physically sick.

example.english: That stinky tofu is really disgusting.
example.jyutping: go2 di1 cau3 dau6 fu6 zan1 hai6 faan2 wai6
